results.title: Notary of Souls
results.overview: Laura, a “young woman” of 126 years old, is the newly hired at Notary of Souls. In her new role, she records the motivations of those who renounced eternity. However, by contract, Laura herself cannot interrupt her tedious existence.

results.title: Extremely Inappropriate! New Years Special
results.original_title: 新年早々 不適切にもほどがある！～真面目な話、しちゃダメですか？～
results.overview: Snarky 1980s PE teacher, Ogawa Ichiro, is back — crashing through the wall of Café Scandal! This time, he's brought along the café "master" and 83-year-old inventor, Inoue, embarking on a new, time warping adventure. After sending Kiyoshi into the past to prevent Yuzuru's fated encounter with daughter, Junko, Ichiro travels to the night of the Great Hanshin Earthquake (1995) and greets a surprise visitor, while learning of an incident coming in 2036.

results.title: Don Quijote in Barcelona
results.overview: Lluc, a former academic with strong cultural ties, and Olli, a man who drifted from Finland to the streets of Barcelona, meet while seeking shelter in the same stairwell. Their beginnings are modest, but gradually a connection develops between them, based not on pity but on shared humanity.

results.title: Haunted House
results.overview: A local businessman wants to demolish an old house where children spend their time playing and growing up, in order to make room for parking his trucks. Luka, one of the boys, seeks help from a monster he believes lives in the house. But when that help comes in the form of his father being injured during the demolition, Luka begins to believe that he is responsible for the accident.

results.title: Yamazaki Riverside - Over an Actor's Shoulder -
results.original_title: 山﨑リバーサイド - 俳優の肩ごしに -
results.overview: The first documentary devoted to actor Yamazaki Tsutomu follows his pursuit of the craft as he confronts old age and cancer.

results.title: The Rise: The Inaugural Season of the PWHL
results.original_title: The Rise: The Inaugural Season of the PWHL
results.overview: In this documentary, the historic inaugural season of the Professional Women's Hockey League is explored through interviews and footage of the adrenaline-pumping games.

results.title: The Anta Claus of the South Pole
results.original_title: The Anta Claus of the South Pole
results.overview: Envious of his northern counterpart, the Anta Claus of the South Pole embarks on a penguin-powered journey to uncover the secret of a flawless Christmas. Along the way, he learns that the true spirit of the holiday lies not in perfection but in the lovable community of oddballs he left behind.

results.title: G.O.D.Tech
results.overview: An adventure thriller about a group of friends trying to escape a government based world religion who treats them as terrorists.ech

results.title: AAA Héroes Inmortales 2026 - Week 1
results.overview: Héroes Inmortales 2026 is a professional wrestling event produced by Lucha Libre AAA Worldwide. It takes place on October 24, 2026, at Gimnasio Olímpico Juan de la Barrera in Mexico City, Mexico.

results.title: Feminismes 76. Quan ens va canviar la vida
results.original_title: Feminismes 76. Quan ens va canviar la vida

results.title: Farewell, Rivers
results.overview: The last inhabitants of a mountain village resist a time that transforms the ways of life in the region. Eladio, the ranger, witnesses the fate of a community where humans disappear and animals remain. While a bear wanders through the valley, invisible threads are weaven that plot stories of care, loss and resistance.

results.title: TV4:s nyårskarameller 2025
results.overview: A star-studded evening from Berns in Stockholm awaits. Tilde de Paula Eby welcomes us and offers an evening of goodies from the year as well as throwbacks as TV4 celebrates its 35th anniversary. The guest list includes Petra Mede, David Hellenius, Carina Berg, Johan Glans, Linda Lindorff, Mauri Hermundsson and Camilla Hamid. Many gems are promised and even a sneak peek at what 2026 has to offer.

results.title: Behind This Locked Door
results.overview: Bea and Sean, a couple in their late 20s, move in together for the first time. As they start their newly shared lives, Bea finds Sean spending a concerning amount of time in the bathroom.

results.title: The Shadows of Trust
results.overview: A couple's idyllic life at a secluded country home unravels as disturbing events uncover buried secrets-and a mysterious neighbor threatens to expose everything.

results.title: Neelira
results.overview: A wedding eve in 1988 Sri Lanka turns into a hostage standoff when Indian Army soldiers occupy a family's home overnight.

results.title: Complications
results.overview: No longer working for the CIA, Dietrich is now a ruthless mercenary on a mission to execute a high value target. But all is not what it seems, and before long the mission becomes a lot more complicated than Dietrich could have imagined.
